inputs.name: hubEnvConfig.input
inputs.description: Candidate hub environment settings supplied when constructing the runtime configuration. The builder copies only allowlisted HARNESS_* values that are strings and truthy DB, CACHE, or REMOTE_HOSTS bindings; other keys and non-string settings are ignored.

outputs.name: hubEnvConfig
outputs.description: The returned configuration object is a HubEnv with allowlisted string-valued HARNESS_* properties and any truthy DB, CACHE, or REMOTE_HOSTS bindings copied from the input. Non-string settings and unrelated keys are omitted, and the implementation does not enforce the declared HARNESS_ENVIRONMENT union at runtime.
